blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Palace Press Officer Claire Castro on Tuesday said those criticizing President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.’s advice for the public to buy buckets and collect water ahead of Super El Niño should instead buy themselves “buckets and buckets of brains” to understand Marcos’ plan. These scathing remarks came amid backlash to the President’s remarks during an interview in Singapore over the weekend, where he urged Filipinos to prepare buckets and other containers to collect rainwater as the government drew up measures to address possible water shortages.
